caption: Sunlight passes through a clear glass of water on a table, and a bright patch of light appears on the table on the far side of the glass.

sa.check: A glass of water stands on a table in sunlight.
A bright patch of light appears on the table on the far side of the glass.

pc.expect: The bright patch lies on the side of the glass away from the sun and would disappear if the glass were taken away.
pc.fail: It lies on the sun side; or it is there with no glass; or the glass is in sunlight and no patch appears.

pc.expect: The patch moves only when the glass moves.
pc.fail: It drifts with the glass still; or it stays put while the glass is moved; or it flickers in steady sun.

pc.expect: The patch is one bright shape roughly the glass's footprint.
pc.fail: It splits into several; or it is a sharp geometric shape unlike the glass; or it floods the table.

pc.expect: The glass is rigid and the water level.
pc.fail: The glass bends; or the water tilts and holds; or the water goes opaque.
A second glass appears; or the patch becomes solid; or the glass vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The glass and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The glass changes shape; or the table changes; or the water changes colour.
